svg.title: Houkyuken — The Lodestone Fist. Draft 4 / Magnet classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration).
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Lodestone Draw forks into Polarized Fist then Starfall Hammer, or Reversed Polarity then Inexorable Pull. Repelling Field forks into Magnetized Guard then Absolute Alignment, or Like Poles Repel then Violent Repulsion. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Magnet jutsu.

The Control trait reaches potency through two stacking 35% enemy Increase Damage Taken rows (Morning Star, all four stat types; Magnetic Assignment, Lightning/Magnet/None/Wind). Defense is one universal 35% Decrease Damage Taken row and one 40% Reflect row, so root Lodestone carries the offense and exposure routes and root Repulsion the defense and counter routes. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Magnet jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Houkyu Dance · Houkyuken: Magnetic Assignment · Morning Star (4
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · REF: Reflect
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE HOUKYUKEN KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Houkyuken: Magnetic Assignment · Decrease Damage Taken
Houkyuken: Magnetic Assignment · Increase Damage Given
Houkyuken: Magnetic Assignment · Increase Damage Taken
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 4 / Magnet classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
